name: Amanda
source:
Boxer, fighter, and desperate for money, Amanda will do anything to pay those pesky bills.

Years in the ring have taught Amanda how to take a hit and how to deal with pain. But with time, that manifested into a dark desire.

Now she craves that pain. While fighting, she learned how to channel suffering and pain into pleasure, but that feeling soon turned sexual.

The thrill of the fight isn't enough anymore. She needs... more. She needs to feel dominated, helpless and vulnerable.

She needs... a master.

[From [url=https://www.dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Amanda]DumbKoala[/url]]
